title: adenophora delavayi

This plant is known for its medicinal properties and is used in traditional Chinese medicine to treat various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of Adenophora delavayi include alkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which have been shown to exhibit therapeutic actions such as anti-oxidative, anti-microbial, and anti-cancer properties.
